missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Опасность' is a feminine soft-sign noun in the nominative case as the subject. 'Была' agrees in the feminine, and 'близко' is the adverb of position.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Опасность' is the accusative direct object of 'почувствовал'. Feminine nouns ending in a soft sign keep the same form in the accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of negation. 'Опасности' is the genitive form after 'нет', expressing absence. 'Никакой' is the agreeing feminine genitive pronoun reinforcing the negation.
Strategic focus: Dative with 'навстречу'. 'Опасности' is the dative form after 'навстречу', expressing movement toward something. The soft-sign feminine dative ends in -и.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject with genitive modifier. 'Опасность' is the nominative subject of 'нависла'. 'Войны' is the genitive modifier, and 'над городом' is the instrumental location.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Об опасности' uses the prepositional form 'опасности' after 'об' to express the topic of thought. The soft-sign feminine prepositional ends in -и.
Strategic focus: Prepositional with 'об'. 'Опасности' is the prepositional form after 'об' used with the verb of warning. 'Их' is the accusative object of 'предупредил'.

missions.phrase: В дороге нас ждали разные опасности.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Опасности' is the nominative plural subject of 'ждали'. 'Разные' is the agreeing plural adjective, and 'нас' is the accusative object.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Опасностей' is the genitive plural required by 'избежать', which governs the genitive. 'Многих' is the agreeing plural genitive quantifier.
Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Опасность' is nominative as the predicate noun. 'Настоящая' is the agreeing feminine adjective, and 'была' agrees in the feminine past.
